requirements.text: The system must allow students to book study rooms from their mobile devices.
The booking process must allow students to easily select a date and time, view room availability, and specify the number of people.
The loan management system must allow students to borrow and return books completely online without visiting the library desk.
The system must allow students to view currently borrowed items along with their due dates.
The renewal process must have a simple online button that allows students to extend the due date of borrowed books.
The system must automatically notify students of any overdue books and associated fines.
The system must send reminders before the due date of borrowed items.
The system must display the total amount owed for fines directly on students' phones.
